title: Natural frequencies of a free beam: rigid-body modes and the first bending mode
source: Euler–Bernoulli free–free beam, β₁L = 4.7300; Timoshenko, Young and Weaver, Vibration Problems in Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 1974, §5.3

quantities.reason: a free body has six zero frequencies; numerical rigid-body frequencies below 10⁻³ of the first elastic one (eigenvalues below 10⁻⁶ of it) are rounding of the shifted solve
Euler–Bernoulli neglects shear and rotary inertia, about 0.8% at L/h = 20 for the free–free mode
the mass matrix integrates the density exactly
